title: Project: Perfomance
description: This project focuses on making modpacks to boost your FPS while playing minecraft. Also includes quality-of-life mods.
body:
In this modpack, you can find lots of performance mod that will boost your framerates, without the cost of newer hardware, and quality.

## WARNING
***
If you ever want to add more mods to this modpack for personal use, you must read the incompatible mods section.

Older versions will be created as soon as the author have time to make the modpack.

## What's inside?

Inside this modpack, there are various amount of mods. If you want to find the list of the mods, the credits, dependencies, and incompatibilities, read [this](https://rentry.org/project-performance) rentry.co list. (UNDER DEVELOPMENT)

## Feedback
***
If you ever want to recommend any more performance mods or report bugs, incompatibilities, etc; you can contact me with [this](mailto:itspixelatd@proton.me) mailto email link.
